services.name: Pontoon Rental
services.desc: Embark on a pontoon adventure, from morning to afternoon or into the enchanting evening. Cruise the pristine waters, bask in the sun, and witness stunning sunsets. Whether it’s thrilling water sports or serene relaxation, our pontoon rentals offer endless possibilities for a memorable day on the water. Experience the ultimate journey from dawn to dusk. Book your pontoon rental now! Your Safety is Important to us! Superior Pontoon Rentals cancels ALL rentals when Alger County is in Severe Weather/Wind Advisories, or when we deem boating unsafe. Note: Your reservation deposit will be refunded if conditions on Lake Superior are not suitable for boating on the day of your scheduled pontoon

variants.label: Pontoon boat rental for cruising Lake Superior

blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats to cruise Lake Superior, enjoying scenery such as Pictured Rocks, Grand Island, and waterfalls. Rentals accommodate from morning to evening with options for water sports or relaxation. The boats hold 8-10 people and require a driver 21 or older with a valid driver's license.
extraNote: No towing of people or BBQing on pontoon · No refund if rental ends early due to unlawful behavior or unsafe boating · Rental fee due according to reserved time even if ended early · All rentals cancelled during severe weather or unsafe conditions · $200 damage deposit required before departure, refundable if no damage · Minimum $30 charge if pontoon excessively dirty · Holiday rentals must be cancelled at least 72 hours before rental · Late cancellation or no-show charged full rental rate · If operator cancels, customer may reschedule without penalty · Munising Bay
